<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C18H19O2 (no N or halogens), DBE = (2*18 + 2 - 19)/2 = 19/2 = 9.5. Since DBE must be an integer for a stable molecule, we round to the nearest whole number, giving 10.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
